# Intelekta Skola

> SIA Intelekta Skola is an AI training company based in Riga, Latvia, teaching practical, hands-on AI skills to businesses, teams, and individuals.

Intelekta Skola offers practical AI courses focused on real workplace tasks rather than theory. The company is registered in Latvia (Reg. No. 40203747500, VAT LV40203747500) and is based at Akmeņu iela 21b, Rīga, Latvia. The site is available in Latvian (primary), English, and Russian via a language switcher.

## Courses

- [AI ieviešana (AI Implementation)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/program.html): How businesses deploy AI systems, workflows, and productivity solutions, step by step, with real examples.
- [ChatGPT un LLM meistarība (ChatGPT & LLM Mastery)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/program.html): Practical AI usage, prompting, workflows, and advanced ChatGPT/Claude techniques for daily work.
- [AI automatizācija sociālajiem tīkliem (AI Automation for Social Media)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/program.html): Automating content creation, scheduling, and publishing with modern AI tools.
- [Individuālais AI kurss (AI Individual Course)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/program.html): Personalized 1:1 training tailored to the learner's goals and profession.
- [Promptu inženierija (Prompt Engineering)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/program.html): Structured prompt-writing for business, creativity, and automation, for repeatable, predictable results.

## Free tools

- [Promptu darbnīca (Prompt Workshop)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/tools/prompt-darbnica/): Pick a business scenario and get a ready-made, professional AI prompt.
- [AI Laika kalkulators (AI Time Calculator)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/tools/laika-kalkulators/): Estimate hours and money a team can save per month by adopting AI.
- [AI Gatavības tests (AI Readiness Test)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/tools/ai-gatavibas-tests/): A short quiz assessing how AI-ready a business is.
